comparison.position: 纯stdlib CPU实现完整正负配对、centered PCA固定顺序、共享分层quantile、forward/reverse KL logit梯度、仅选中行的hidden/weight梯度。小矩阵以多坐标起点的power iteration估计首主成分，与上游随机PCA实现不同但保留论文定义的几何顺序机制。精确积分所有CDF区间检验无偏性，有限差分独立核对KL梯度；top-coordinate丢弃是有偏负控。没有Transformer、CUDA kernel、真实teacher cache、学生生成、能力benchmark或吞吐测量。
comparison.tradeoff: SimOPD在各自表示空间匹配回答间的相似度分布，改变监督目标；DWE保持既定KL目标，只改变反向梯度估计和输出行计算。二者可在设计上组合，但SimOPD的关系分布不是DWE已经支持的真实LLM路径；本轮也未验证联合训练。

analysis.title: DWE与SimOPD都叫蒸馏改进，改变的是同一轴吗？
analysis.body: SimOPD在各自表示空间匹配回答间的相似度分布，改变监督目标；DWE保持既定KL目标，只改变反向梯度估计和输出行计算。二者可在设计上组合，但SimOPD的关系分布不是DWE已经支持的真实LLM路径；本轮也未验证联合训练。 来源：§2 Eq.2–3；§3 Eq.4–15。U_k独立均匀分布于((k−1)/K,k/K)，正负CDF共用U_k。反传实际计算Wᵀĝ与ĝhᵀ；不能先做完整稠密反传再屏蔽。reverse KL的logit梯度为p_i[log(p_i/q_i)−KL(p‖q)]，同样和为零。固定顺序可近似几何，但不是每步重排或把教师/学生词表ID混用。

question.question: DWE与SimOPD都叫蒸馏改进，改变的是同一轴吗？
question.answer: 不是。SimOPD匹配回答关系分布，改变监督内容；DWE保持已有KL目标，只用无偏稀疏估计替换输出头反传。两者理论上可组合，但组件通过不证明联合LLM训练或能力收益。
question.example: 教学例：换成相似度bank的KL是换目标；同一token KL用8对坐标估计其梯度是换估计器。

comparison.position: Pure-standard-library CPU code executes positive/negative pairing, a centered-PCA cached order, shared stratified quantiles, forward/reverse-KL logit gradients and selected-row hidden/weight gradients. Multiple-start power iteration on tiny matrices differs from upstream randomized PCA but preserves the paper's principal-direction mechanism. Exact integration over all CDF intervals checks unbiasedness; finite differences independently verify KL gradients. Discarded top-coordinate gradients are a biased negative control. No Transformer, CUDA kernel, real teacher cache, student generation, capability benchmark or throughput measurement is provided.
comparison.tradeoff: SimOPD matches answer-to-answer similarity distributions in separate representation spaces, changing supervision. DWE retains a chosen KL objective and changes its backward estimator and row computation. They could be composed in principle, but this does not establish a real LLM integration or joint-training result.

analysis.title: Do DWE and SimOPD change the same distillation axis?
analysis.body: SimOPD matches answer-to-answer similarity distributions in separate representation spaces, changing supervision. DWE retains a chosen KL objective and changes its backward estimator and row computation. They could be composed in principle, but this does not establish a real LLM integration or joint-training result. Sources: Section 2, Eqs.2–3; Section 3, Eqs.4–15. Each U_k is independent uniform on ((k−1)/K,k/K), shared between the positive and negative CDFs. Backpropagation computes Wᵀĝ and ĝhᵀ from selected rows; masking a previously computed dense backward pass does not implement its savings. Reverse-KL gradients p_i[log(p_i/q_i)−KL(p‖q)] also sum to zero. The cached order approximates geometry; it is not rebuilt each step, and teacher/student token IDs must align.

question.question: Do DWE and SimOPD change the same distillation axis?
question.answer: No. SimOPD changes supervision to relational answer distributions. DWE retains an existing KL objective and substitutes an unbiased sparse output-head estimator. Possible composition does not establish joint LLM training or capability gains.
question.example: Teaching example: replacing token KL with similarity-bank KL changes the objective; estimating that same token KL with eight coordinate pairs changes its estimator.

analysis.title: RLOO消去共同常数是否也消去重分词漂移？
analysis.body: DFRL改变奖励来自何种下游决策成本，RLOO消去同一实例共有常数；本篇固定奖励和优势，检查编码怎样改变score-gradient。baseline消去共同regret常数并不使不同token路径的Jacobian相同；不能把reward不变误写成更新不变。 来源：§2 Eq.1–2、§4 Proposition1及AppendixE。采样ab时，coarse完整score步为λ(e_ab−π)；fine只更新root和a后继行，b行不动，所以fine的ba/bb比不变。若π(ba)≠π(bb)，共同更新仅能为零；均匀分布的对称例外不满足这个前提，不能宣称所有分布绝无非零一致步。论文AppendixE还明确区分仅更新sampled-logit的较弱模拟器，本地使用完整softmax梯度而非该替代。

question.question: RLOO消去共同常数是否也消去重分词漂移？
question.answer: 不会。DFRL的hindsight成本作为同实例常数在优势中抵消；重分词改变乘在优势上的score-gradient。奖励轴的抵消与参数化轴的不变性是两回事。
question.example: 教学例：同一优势1分别乘两个不同方向的score向量，结果仍不同；给两者reward同时减10不会让向量重合。

comparison.position: CPU prefix-softmax tables are initialized by the chain rule from one strictly positive complete string distribution and execute full λ_t(e_token−π_row) gradients. Checks cover unvisited rows, coarse unsampled logits and the resulting string distributions. The c and ratio-of-means R utilities are implemented separately; independent tabular parameter spaces are never presented as shared LLM parameters for R. R accepts externally measured updates in one common parameter space. A nonzero matching step under a uniform distribution is a symmetric positive control. No real BPE, LoRA, AdamW, rollout generation or repair algorithm is provided. This is a mechanism diagnostic, not a post-training capability.
comparison.tradeoff: DFRL changes downstream decision-cost feedback, and RLOO cancels a shared within-instance constant. This paper holds rewards and advantages fixed and asks how encoding changes score gradients. Baseline cancellation does not equalize different token-path Jacobians; unchanged rewards do not imply unchanged updates.

analysis.title: Does RLOO's constant cancellation remove retokenization drift?
analysis.body: DFRL changes downstream decision-cost feedback, and RLOO cancels a shared within-instance constant. This paper holds rewards and advantages fixed and asks how encoding changes score gradients. Baseline cancellation does not equalize different token-path Jacobians; unchanged rewards do not imply unchanged updates. Sources: Section2, Eqs.1–2; Section4, Proposition1; AppendixE. Sampling ab gives the coarse full-score step λ(e_ab−π). The fine policy updates only the root and a-successor rows, leaving the b row and ba/bb odds fixed. When π(ba)≠π(bb), agreement requires a zero step. The uniform symmetric exception violates that premise, so a universal no-nonzero-step claim would be false. AppendixE separately describes a weaker sampled-logit-only simulator; local code uses the full softmax gradient instead.

question.question: Does RLOO's constant cancellation remove retokenization drift?
question.answer: No. DFRL's shared hindsight-cost constant cancels within advantages. Retokenization changes the score-gradient multiplied by those advantages. Cancellation on the reward axis is not parameterization invariance.
question.example: Teaching example: advantage1 multiplying two different score vectors still gives different updates. Subtracting10 from both rewards does not align those vectors.

analysis.title: CTRL能与CoLiR回放预算直接相乘算总加速吗？
analysis.body: CoLiR选择应回放哪些历史prompt、后续由当前策略生成新响应；CTRL决定同一批训练与生成怎样共享硬件和发布时间。一个是数据预算/记忆选择，一个是系统布局/版本合同，互不替代。免额外生成来构建CoLiR记忆也不消除训练rollout成本，不能据此把CTRL系统加速直接叠乘。 来源：§3.3 Eq.1及publication gate、§3.4 Eq.3。b(y)是包括跨刷新续写时的最早behavior版本，而非最终完成时版本。publication g在仍有dispatch p且g−p+1≥T的请求时等待；FIFO消费与W≤T warmup一起支撑陈旧度界。P的下界指导测量和SM share选择，不保证下界可达，也不是CPU调度模拟可以证实的吞吐收益。

question.question: CTRL能与CoLiR回放预算直接相乘算总加速吗？
question.answer: 不能。CoLiR改变保存与采样哪些历史prompt，CTRL改变训练和生成的硬件布局与publication。两者开销与瓶颈可能重叠，必须做真实联合系统对照；本轮两者组件都不提供这种证据。

comparison.position: Review-only catalog entry and cost assessment: no local CTRL implementation, CUDA path, benchmark, metric receipt or Evolve operator. Neither equations nor CPU timing fixtures are presented as a CUDA co-residency system. Fixed-version facts, mechanism, original figure and non-winning regimes are preserved without fabricated metrics.
comparison.tradeoff: CoLiR selects historical prompts and later regenerates responses with the current policy. CTRL controls hardware sharing and publication for training and generation. Data-budget/memory selection and system-layout/version contracts are separate axes. Reusing rollouts to build CoLiR memory does not remove later generation cost, so its savings cannot simply multiply CTRL's system speedups.

analysis.title: Can CTRL and CoLiR savings simply be multiplied?
analysis.body: CoLiR selects historical prompts and later regenerates responses with the current policy. CTRL controls hardware sharing and publication for training and generation. Data-budget/memory selection and system-layout/version contracts are separate axes. Reusing rollouts to build CoLiR memory does not remove later generation cost, so its savings cannot simply multiply CTRL's system speedups. Sources: Section3.3, Eq.1 and publication gate; Section3.4, Eq.3. b(y) is the earliest behavior version, including across resumed generation, not the completion version. Publication of g waits while requests dispatched at p satisfy g−p+1≥T; FIFO consumption with W≤T warmup closes the staleness bound. The lower bound on P guides measurement and SM-share selection. It does not guarantee attainability or permit a CPU scheduling sketch to establish throughput gains.

question.question: Can CTRL and CoLiR savings simply be multiplied?
question.answer: No. CoLiR chooses stored and replayed historical prompts; CTRL changes hardware layout and publication for training/generation. Costs and bottlenecks can overlap, requiring a real combined-system control absent here.
question.example: Teaching example: after removing a rollout batch, the learner may become the bottleneck, so an SM share tuned for long rollout may no longer be optimal.
